posts.title: Sep-Oct-Nov graduations…
posts.description: We’ve had three graduation sessions recently (September, October, November), with students from the group graduating in all of them. Here’s a quick update (with congrats to all the new graduates, and thanks for working with me and my group!).

posts.title: Gravitational-wave hierarchical inference from population samples
posts.description: When doing gravitational-wave population fits (the notorious Bayesian hierarchical analyses), one typically relies on models that can be evaluated. That means I have the PDF of the model. This seems fair—what’s wrong with that? But in practice, it prevents a lot of applications.
